title: Simple Hierarchical Planning with Diffusion

methods.one_paragraph_description: Hierarchical Diffuser with Dense Actions: a high-level Sparse Diffuser (SD-DA) trained on subsampled trajectories of every K-th state plus all intermediate actions (dense actions) generates a sequence of H subgoals via return-guided sampling (guidance function predicts return of the full trajectory), discarding actions; then a low-level Diffuser of sequence length K+1, with endpoints clamped to adjacent subgoals at every denoising step and its own return guidance, generates dense state-action segments between subgoals, in parallel. In per-step-replanning environments only the first segment is sampled and the first action executed.
methods.conventional_lineage_hint: diffusion-based planning / hierarchical planning for offline RL ('we introduce a diffusion-based hierarchical planning framework for decision-making problems ... on standard offline-RL benchmarks')

methods.one_paragraph_description: Hierarchical Diffuser: same two-level planner but the high-level Sparse Diffuser models only the subsampled states (every K-th state, actions removed) with a guidance function that predicts the full-trajectory return; low-level Diffuser refines each subgoal-to-subgoal segment.
